description: Points d'accès au WiFi gratuit de la ville de Châteauroux is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by CHATEAUROUX METROPOLE. Location of free internet access points offered by Châteauroux Métropole in WIFI technology accessible to the general public. Name of WIFI network: “ChateaurouxMetropole”. Coverage: CHATEAUROUX METROPOLE. The portal shows the English title as "Access points to free WiFi in the city of Châteauroux" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is CHATEAUROUX METROPOLE. Its keywords include hotspot, infrastucture, sans-fil, connectivite, outdoor, wifi. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-04-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
